claims.text: Greg Short recommends that e-commerce entrepreneurs launch simultaneously on Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop once a product has passed an initial consumer validation batch, rather than sequencing platforms one at a time. Condition: proof-of-concept validation via a first consumer batch must precede simultaneous multi-platform launch to avoid locking in negative reviews on Amazon.
claims.speaker: Greg Short
conditions: product has completed at least one consumer batch
initial product tweaks have been made based on first-batch feedback
seller wants to avoid 1-star reviews on Amazon from an unrefined product
claims.mechanism: Launching on all three platforms simultaneously maximizes total addressable revenue surface; Amazon's review system permanently penalizes early-batch defects, so pre-validation removes the primary risk of simultaneous launch.
bounded_by: Does not apply before proof-of-concept consumer batch is complete

claims.text: Greg Short asserts that among e-commerce businesses running the Shopify + Amazon + TikTok Shop combination (as of approximately 2024-2025), Shopify represents the smallest share of revenue, Amazon represents close to the majority share, and TikTok Shop represents a solid 30-40% of revenue.
claims.speaker: Greg Short
conditions: business is operating on all three platforms simultaneously

numbers.axis: share of total e-commerce revenue by platform

bounded_by: Pattern observed only in businesses running all three channels; single-channel businesses excluded

claims.text: Greg Short argues that a new e-commerce product should be run through a first consumer batch before launching on Amazon, because Amazon's star-rating system permanently records early 1-star reviews that are difficult to recover from, and all first batches tend to generate some negative reviews.
claims.speaker: Greg Short
conditions: new physical product with no prior consumer validation
claims.mechanism: First-batch products invariably have defects that generate 1-star reviews; Amazon's review system weights early reviews heavily in product ranking and buyer trust, making early negative reviews disproportionately damaging to long-term sales velocity.
bounded_by: Does not apply to products with prior validation data (e.g., existing brick-and-mortar sales)

practices.text: Start your e-commerce business on Shopify first to gain a proof-of-concept before expanding to Amazon and TikTok Shop.
Run your initial product batch through consumers and make product tweaks before launching on Amazon to avoid locking in 1-star reviews on an unrefined product.
